description.value: Operating for over 30 years, this artisan bakery on Vancouver's Davie Street produces traditional-style breads, pastries, muffins, and gluten-free baked goods using no preservatives or artificial ingredients. It is notably the premier film-industry catering provider in Vancouver, supplying on-location production sets across Metro Vancouver. The Davie Street shop offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a comfortable stop in the heart of the West End.
